# Transition vocabulary

Synthetic reference, recorded 2026-10-08T08:00:00Z.

Connection acquisition ends when a usable application connection lease is
obtained; command execution is a later span. A healthy bounded window is not
peak-load capacity approval.

Signing-key overlap allows valid old-key and new-key tokens during transition.
A local verification matrix and a production rollout are different milestones.
Similar overlap language in schema transitions refers to consumer payload
compatibility, not token verification or pool capacity.
